name: itch.io
shortDescription: Searches itch.io and tracks game uploads using public itch.io pages.
description:
Search itch.io and track the downloads of its games.
itch.io has no public API for this, so the plugin reads public pages and can break when the site changes.Versions are the uploads of a game (with the version name if the developer provides one) and have no dates,so Gameyfin cannot tell which one is newest. itch.io has no DLC or editions.
